rules: First set of every free-weight lift is a warm-up at half weight. Every session.
Leave 2–3 reps in the tank on every work set. If rep 8 gets ugly, rack it — that set still counts.
Add 5 lb only after two consecutive sessions with every rep clean.
Sharp pain = stop, swap back to the machine version, tell Lexi.
New free-weight moves: rehearse at home on video with light dumbbells before their gym debut.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Heels planted · elbows brush inside of knees at the bottom · chest up · stand tall between reps

exercises.name: DB bench press
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades pinched under you · feet flat · wrists stacked over elbows · to mid-chest

exercises.name: One-arm DB row
exercises.cue: Hand and knee on bench · back flat as a table · pull to the hip, not the armpit · no twist

exercises.name: Farmer carry
exercises.cue: Stand TALL · shoulders back and down · no leaning

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Straight line ear to ankle · squeeze glutes · no sagging hips

exercises.name: DB Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees set once · hips push BACK · shins vertical · flat back · stop at the hamstring stretch · lower on a SLOW 3-count

exercises.name: Seated DB shoulder press
exercises.cue: Back-support bench · forearms vertical · ribs down, no arching · press to lockout without shrugging

exercises.name: Bent-over DB reverse fly
exercises.cue: Hinge like the RDL · arms hang · raise to the sides with soft elbows · squeeze the shoulder blades · no swing

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Low back PRESSED to the floor · opposite arm and leg · slow

bookends.warmup: Warm-up: 5 min easy cardio + half-weight set of each lift
bookends.cooldown: The Cooldown Five: hamstring · hip-flexor · doorway chest · figure-4 glute · calf — 30 sec a side

rower-intervals.name: Rower intervals
rower-intervals.hint: 5 min easy, 6 × (2 hard / 1 easy), 5 easy. Record the average watts of the hard pieces.

other.name: Other
other.hint: Yard work, painting, pilates — it all counts.
